summary: Nez Perce National Forest lookout in Idaho County: 1931 tower (sources disagree on its type), 100-foot steel tower from 1953, last staffed 1969, removed 1972.

facts.design: First tower 1931: 60-foot wooden with 7x7 cab per two sites (Forest Lookouts lists 90-foot steel); replaced 1953 by a 100-foot steel tower
facts.status_note: Removed in 1972 per two sites; a University of Idaho photo dated approximately 1951 shows the old tower lying on the ground

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The two University of Idaho items share the title 'Jack Mountain Lookout cabin and tower' and place it 14 miles south by southeast of Elk City in Idaho County. We matched them to this lookout on title and location only.

notes_for_editor: Verification 2026-10-10: the story now says the UIdaho photo was matched to this lookout by its title. The UIdaho photo's own coordinates (45.80014, -115.430217) are about 20 km north of the brief's 45.627, -115.382, so the photo-to-lookout link is unconfirmed by location. All 16 quotes were found on the first run. Conflicts left open in the story: the 1931 tower (60-foot wooden with 7x7 cab per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; 90-foot steel per Forest Lookouts) and the timeline (UIdaho photo dated approximately 1951 showing the tower down, against a 1953 replacement and 1972 removal). Brief coordinates 45.627, -115.382 were not checked against Elk City; the UIdaho photo says 14 miles SSE. Brief record had no events; added from these sources. The existing brief photo (idahofirelookouts jackmtn1) is not repeated. Staffer name is as printed by Idaho Fire Lookouts and not verified further.
